title: Ericsson (ERIC) - Revenue
paragraphs: According toEricsson's latest financial reports the company's current revenue (TTM) is$23.84 Billion USD. In 2024 the company made a revenue of$23.35 Billion USDa decrease over the revenue in the year 2023 that were of$25.01 Billion USD. The revenue is the total amount of income that a company generates by the sale of goods or services. Unlike with theearningsno expenses are subtracted.
